items.title: Somalia: UN Puts Somalia Mission Assets Up for Sale As U.S. Funding Cutoff Looms
items.description: [Radio Dalsan] Mogadishu, Somalia -- The United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS) has opened a tender seeking licensed auctioneers to sell off a wide range of its vehicles, generators and other equipment in Somalia, a notice published on the UN Global Marketplace shows.

items.title: The first Senegalese selected for the “New Destinies” project visited the embassy
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to Dakar, Michele Tommasi, welcomed the first twelve Senegalese workers who will soon take part in the “New Destinies – New Horizons” project in Italy, in the presence of representatives from institutions, training organizations, and partners involved in the initiative. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.

items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - The Italian Ambassador to the Republic of Kenya and the Seychelles, Vincenzo Del Monaco, met with the Governor of the Central Bank of Kenya, Kamau Thugge, with whom he had “an important exchange of information.” “It was an opportunity to discuss the country’s economic situation,” the embassy noted, “and the growing bilateral relationship between Italy and Kenya.” Read article...

items.title: Sierra Leone president presses lawmakers to back contested election reforms
items.description: Sierra Leone’s President Julius Maada Bio has urged Parliament to pass disputed electoral reforms that would lower the presidential victory threshold, introduce proportional representation and reserve 30 percent of political leadership positions for women.

items.title: Centemero, 'porterò all'Onu candidatura di Milano come hub per governance etica IA'
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 07 AGO - "L'Italia ha davanti un'opportunità strategica: non limitarsi a partecipare al dibattito sull'intelligenza artificiale, ma contribuire a costruirne la futura governance globale. items.title: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
items.description: Pope Leo called for peace in Sudan on Sunday during an address at the Vatican. Leo singled out El-Obeid, the beseiged capital of North Kordofan state. Residents are facing a lack food, water and medical supplies as fighting in the city continues.
items.titleIt: Pope Leo XIV calls for humanitarian corridor in Sudan
